name: A thinker's harvest status (the Referee)

values.gloss: created, identity not yet confirmed (the column default)
identity confirmed, harvest not started (the UI says Ready)
harvest finished with gaps, coverage not closed
harvest closed, gaps could not be resolved (rare; the closure path can still set it)

note: Confirmed by the Referee 2026-09-06 (docs corrected on their main). Field `status` on cohort-context members[], /api/thinkers/{id} and /api/thinkers/search; a free column by convention, the Referee tells first if a value is added. incomplete = a closed harvest with gaps (since the 2026-09-05 harvest fixes); complete = coverage closed; exhausted_with_gaps is a rare sixth state, not legacy. A zero against a complete thinker is stronger than one against a pending one.
